Box 1128 Beaufort, SC 29901-1228 In Person: Beaufort or Bluffton Office By Phone: 843-255-6900 To return Absentee Ballots: 7:00 p.m. on Election Day (November 3, 2026) Early Voting : October 19 - 31 (Monday - Saturday) from 8:30 a.m. - 6:00 p.m. Locations Beaufort Main Office: 15 John Galt Rd. Beaufort, SC 29906 St Helena Branch Library: 6355 Jonathan Francis Senior Rd. St Helena Island, SC 29920 Bluffton Branch Library: 120 Palmetto Way. Bluffton, SC 29910 USCB- HHI: 1 Sand Shark Dr. Hilton Head Island, SC 29928 Board of Voter Registration and Elections of Beaufort County We manage registration of Beaufort County voters and administer elections in a manner that instills confidence in electors that they are actively participating in a fundamental component of representative democracy. Beaufort Office: 15 John Galt Rd Beaufort, SC 29906 Phone: (843) 255-6900 Fax: (843) 524-0617 or (843) 255-9429 Office Hours: Monday – Friday 8 am - 5 pm Bluffton Office: Satellite Office Myrtle Park Government Center 4819 Bluffton Parkway Bluffton, SC 29910 Phone: 843-255-6940 Office Hours: 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM Mail ALL Correspondence To: Board of Voter Registration and Elections of Beaufort County Post Office Box 1228 Beaufort, SC 29901-1228 Email us at Vote.Beaufort@Elections.SC.Gov for voting questions.
